title: Why Your CSV Total Is Wrong: 3 Data-Cleaning Bugs in Python
description: A fictional 8-row invoice CSV gives the wrong total if duplicate invoices are counted twice. Watch original Python code inspect hidden spaces, normalize invoice IDs, verify duplicates and use Decimal for accurate cents. Our sample calculates $2,656.25 before cleaning and $1,430.75 after removing two verified duplicates. This is fictional demonstration data, not financial advice or customer records. Verify duplicate business rules for your own files. Python documentation: https://docs.python.org/3/library/csv.html and https://docs.python.org/3/library/decimal.html
cover: Choose an unmodified actual recorded Python terminal frame showing $2656.25 before and $1430.75 after; identify both totals as fictional sample data, no invented screen.
